purpose: Create the repository-owned migration history used by the dedicated migration step.
lockImpact: Creates a new schema and table only; it does not lock application-owned tables.
dataImpact: Creates an empty technical migration registry and does not alter application data.
backfill: Not required; the registry starts empty on the first managed migration run.
recovery: Before production use, restore the reviewed empty-database recovery point. After later migrations exist, do not drop migration history mechanically.
forwardFix: Append a new reviewed migration that repairs the registry without rewriting an applied migration.
